project: Sumplus Arsenal - Skills Platform for Agents
description: A comprehensive platform for agents to discover, search, and use skills, with support for MCP, function calling, and web interface
techStack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

features.title: Project foundation and database schema
features.description: Set up Next.js project with TypeScript, Supabase integration, and define database schema for skills, users, ratings, and payments
testCriteria: Database tables created (skills, users, ratings, payments)

features.title: Skills data model and API foundation
features.description: Create Skills model with metadata (name, description, category, author, version), implement basic CRUD API routes
testCriteria: Skills table has all required fields

features.title: Skills search and filtering
features.description: Implement full-text search, category filtering, tag filtering, and sorting capabilities for skills

features.title: Web interface - Home and Browse page
features.description: Create responsive home page with featured skills, search bar, and browse page with grid/list view
testCriteria: Home page loads and displays featured skills
Browse page shows all skills in grid view
Can switch between grid and list view

features.title: Web interface - Skill detail page
features.description: Create skill detail page showing full description, usage examples, ratings, comments, and try-it functionality
testCriteria: Detail page shows all skill information

features.title: User authentication system
features.description: Implement user signup/login with Supabase Auth, support for both human users and agent authentication
testCriteria: User can sign up with email/password
Agent can authenticate with API key

features.title: Skill upload system
features.description: Create upload interface for official and third-party users to submit skills with validation and moderation queue
testCriteria: Upload form validates all required fields
Skills are created with pending status

features.title: Rating and review system
features.description: Implement rating (1-5 stars) and review functionality with aggregated scores and comment threads
testCriteria: Reviews are displayed on skill page
One rating per user per skill enforced

features.title: MCP interface
features.description: Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface for skills discovery and usage by AI agents

features.title: Function calling interface
features.description: Implement OpenAI-compatible function calling interface for agents to discover and use skills
testCriteria: Results are returned in correct format

features.title: Skills execution API
features.description: Create unified API for executing skills with input validation, timeout handling, and result formatting

features.title: SUI blockchain skill
features.description: Create official skill for SUI blockchain operations (query balance, send transaction, get block info)

features.title: Crypto wallet skill
features.description: Create skill for interacting with crypto wallets (check balance, generate address, sign message)
testCriteria: Check balance works for multiple chains

features.title: Sumplus Yield service skill
features.description: Create skill for interacting with Sumplus Yield service from sumpl.us (get rates, calculate yield, invest)

features.title: X402 payment integration
features.description: Implement X402 payment protocol for paid skills and future MCP services with payment verification

features.title: Router functionality
features.description: Implement arsenal as a router - agents use arsenal's unified API to access any skill without installation
testCriteria: Single API endpoint routes to skills
No skill installation needed by agents

features.title: Admin dashboard
features.description: Create admin interface for managing skills, users, reviewing submissions, and monitoring system

features.title: API documentation
features.description: Create comprehensive API documentation with examples for all interfaces (REST, MCP, Function Calling)

features.title: End-to-end testing
features.description: Create comprehensive test suite covering all features with Playwright for E2E and Jest for unit tests

features.title: Deployment and production setup
features.description: Deploy to Vercel, configure production Supabase, set up monitoring and analytics
